title: fix(advisory-convergence): bind self-referential-bootstrap-auto markers to the run that posted them
body:
# fix(advisory-convergence): bind self-referential-bootstrap-auto markers to the run that posted them

## Background

During review of PR #2895 (issue #2657), a Codex P1 finding identified
a residual trust gap in `verifySelfReferentialBootstrapWaiverRun`
(`src/scripts/advisory-convergence.mts`): the automatic
self-referential-bootstrap-auto waiver's `run-id:` field is checked
against `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run-id}` for the
right workflow path, head SHA, repository, and event type
(`pull_request_target`) — but none of that proves the CITED run is the
one that actually posted the comment. The run id is bearer evidence,
not provenance-bound.

A same-repository `pull_request`-triggered workflow with
`issues: write` (an actor this mechanism's own comments already assume
can post arbitrary `github-actions[bot]`-authored comments — see
`collectFromGitHub`'s existing rate-limit-exhaustion-guard comments)
can discover a legitimate, concurrently running `pull_request_target`
run of `idd-advisory-convergence.yml` for its own PR (via the public
Actions API) and cite that run's id in a forged marker. All four
existing trust conditions on the cited run would still pass.

## Why this is scoped narrower than it first looks

`autoWaiverValid` also requires `touchesSelfReferentialAllowlist`,
which is fetched independently from the PR's own live file-changes API
(`listChangeRequestChangedFiles` / `listChangeRequestRenamedFromPaths`),
never from the attacker-controlled comment. A forged marker therefore
cannot make a PR that does NOT touch the checker allowlist validate —
it can only let a PR that already legitimately qualifies for the
waiver receive it via forgery instead of via the real job. The
allowlist check remains the load-bearing security boundary.

One concrete exploit this bearer-evidence gap DID enable was closed
directly in PR #2895 (see the `claimCandidateAmbiguous` fix in
`src/scripts/advisory-convergence.mts`): a forged `claim-id:none`
marker could validate on a PR whose closing issues expose ambiguous,
multiple active claims — a state `selectLinkedIssueCandidate`
(`external-check-waiver.mts`) always refuses to auto-post ANY marker
for. That narrow gap is now closed; this issue tracks the general
provenance-binding problem the narrow fix does not attempt to solve.

## Proposed change

Bind a candidate marker's provenance to the run it cites, rather than
trusting the cited run's own metadata as sufficient. Two directions
worth evaluating:

1. **Run-log correlation.** The posting job's own run log (or its
   jobs API) records the exact comment it created (e.g. via
   `gh api .../issues/comments` in its own step output, or the API
   response the posting step already receives). Fetch the cited run's
   jobs/steps and confirm it actually performed a POST to the issue
   comments endpoint that would explain this exact comment id/body/
   timestamp, rather than trusting the run merely EXISTS with the
   right shape.
2. **Trusted creation-window binding.** Narrow the acceptable window
   between the cited run's own `created_at`/`updated_at` and the
   marker comment's `createdAt` tightly enough that only the actual
   posting run's own brief execution window could have produced it,
   combined with a per-run "already consumed" marker to prevent one
   legitimate run's window from covering multiple forged comments.

Either direction is new I/O (bounded, following the same
`MAX_AUTO_WAIVER_RUN_LOOKUPS`-style budget discipline already used for
run-id lookups) and new fixture/test surface — not a small patch, which
is why it was tracked here rather than attempted live during PR #2895's
review.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A forged marker citing a real, legitimate, concurrently-running
      `pull_request_target` run's id (but not actually posted by that
      run) is rejected by `verifySelfReferentialBootstrapWaiverRun` or
      its replacement, verified by a fake-provider test.
- [ ] A genuine marker posted by the real `idd-advisory-convergence-
      self-waiver` job continues to validate, with no new manual step
      required by adopters.
- [ ] Any new lookup this needs is bounded the same way
      `MAX_AUTO_WAIVER_RUN_LOOKUPS` already bounds run-id lookups in
      `collectFromGitHub`.
- [ ] Full validation gate green (typecheck, build, `node --test
      tests/*.test.mts`, cspell, biome, dprint, markdownlint,
      `audit-code-span-wrap.mjs`, `audit-docs.mjs --check`).

Refs #2657
